name: FeO (B1)
notes: Consolidated B1 FeO entry from equivalent cubic beamline JCPDS cards. The Fischer et al. record is composition-specific to Fe0.94O.

eos_records.label: (Fei et al. Miner. Spectros. (5) 1996)

reference.source: in Mineral Physics & Crystallography, AGU Reference Shelf

eos_records.notes: Fei's review tabulates the recommended B1 FeO values K0 = 145 GPa with K0' fixed at 4.0, but gives no parameter uncertainties. A composition-specific Fischer et al. fit is included in this material.

eos_records.label: B1 Fe0.94O, Fischer et al. (2011)
eos_records.notes: Fischer et al. fit Fe0.94O with molar V0 = 12.256 cm^3/mol fixed, K0 = 149.4 +/- 1.0 GPa, and K0' = 3.60 +/- 0.04. V0 was converted to the conventional Z=4 B1 cell.
